evidence.text: How do neutral-current non-standard interactions (NC-NSI), non-unitary neutrino mixing (NUNM), and flavor-dependent long-range interactions modify neutrino oscillations, and how can long-baseline experiments and astrophysical flavor measurements constrain them? Neutrino mass generation itself is outside the thesis's focus.

sources.title: Testing beyond the Standard Model scenarios in next-generation long-baseline neutrino oscillation experiments

evidence.text: How sensitively can next-generation long-baseline experiments constrain or discover flavor-dependent long-range interactions, Lorentz invariance violation (LIV), and active–sterile oscillations through changes in neutrino probabilities and event spectra?

sources.title: Leptogenesis with Majoron dark matter

evidence.text: Can one minimal Majoron model jointly account for light neutrino masses, freeze-in dark matter and baryon asymmetry, with the same explicit lepton-number-breaking operators controlling dark matter production and resonant leptogenesis?

sources.title: Neutrino Masses from Outer Space

evidence.text: Background-field expansion φ=φ0+ϕ and H=v+h, treating mS=gφ0 as locally constant over times shorter than H−1. The authors evaluate leading renormalized one-loop contributions to the scalar mass, Higgs–φ biquadratic coupling, and φ quartic; full Coleman–Weinberg resummation is mentioned but not required for their estimates.

sources.title: Model of metastable EeV dark matter

evidence.text: The authors diagonalize the neutrino mass matrix and expand interactions at small active–sterile mixing θ. Appendix calculations compare two-, three- and higher-body dark-matter decay widths, retaining neutrino-mass and mixing suppressions.

sources.title: Neutrino charge constraints from scattering to the weak gravity conjecture to neutron stars

evidence.text: Solve hypercharge anomaly-cancellation conditions together with gauge invariance of Yukawa interactions. The conditions include mixed nonabelian–hypercharge anomalies, the cubic hypercharge anomaly, and the mixed gauge–gravitational anomaly, whose redundancy depends on the scenario.

sources.title: Sterile neutrino dark matter catalyzed by a very light dark photon

evidence.text: Use a relativistic two-state Hamiltonian with V_a=V_W+δV_a and δV_a=[(g′A′)²−2g′p·A′]/(2p). Resonance requires 2pV_a+m²_aa=m²_ss≈m²_s, hence a sufficiently positive active matter contribution.

sources.title: Gravitational waves-tomography of Low-Scale-Leptogenesis

evidence.text: A finite-temperature scalar potential is used to characterize symmetry breaking. Action-angle averaging gives I∝a^−3 and, for V∝Φ^β, w=(β−2)/(β+2); quadratic oscillations therefore supply the matter-like epoch.

sources.title: Pseudo-Dirac neutrinos and relic neutrino matter effect on the high-energy neutrino flavor composition

evidence.text: Average rapid standard oscillations over astrophysical baselines, using Pαβ=Σ_i|Uαi|²|Uβi|². Flavor triangles use NuFit 5.3 best fits and 68% allowed ranges, assuming normal ordering for concreteness.

sources.title: Probing Scalar Non-Standard Neutrino Interactions using High-Energy Astrophysical Neutrinos

evidence.text: Can scalar interactions with the cosmic neutrino background induce pseudo-Dirac splittings detectable through astrophysical neutrino flavor composition and spectral distortions?

sources.title: Theory and phenomenology of Dirac neutrinos

evidence.text: How can symmetry-protected seesaw and radiative mechanisms explain small Dirac neutrino masses while connecting neutrino nature to dark matter stability, flavour predictions and observable charged lepton flavour violation?

sources.title: Direct neutrino-mass measurement based on 259 days of KATRIN data

evidence.text: What bound on the effective electron antineutrino mass follows from KATRIN's first five tritium endpoint measurement campaigns? The kinematic approach is independent of cosmological models and of whether neutrinos are Dirac or Majorana.

sources.title: Testing the number of neutrino species with a global fit of neutrino data

evidence.text: Can terrestrial oscillation and direct neutrino-mass data constrain the additional neutrino copies of the Dvali–Redi (DR) model through its correlated oscillation pattern, without adopting a cosmological history?

sources.title: The Dark Dimension and Majorana Neutrinos

evidence.text: What terrestrial constraints apply to genuinely five-dimensional Lorentz-invariant bulk Majorana neutrinos, and how do oscillations, beta decay and neutrinoless double beta decay test the proposed Dark-Dimension window?

sources.title: Quantum gravitational decoherence in the three neutrino flavor scheme

evidence.text: Can quantum-gravitational decoherence of astrophysical neutrinos reveal additional neutral fermions through total-flux suppression and energy-dependent flavor ratios in a realistic three-active-neutrino system?

sources.title: Flavor-Dependent Long-Range Neutrino Interactions in DUNE and T2HK: Synergy Breeds Power

evidence.text: How strongly could DUNE and T2HK constrain or discover flavor-dependent long-range neutrino interactions, and how does their combination alleviate degeneracies with standard oscillation parameters?

sources.title: Neutrino nonstandard interactions via light scalars in the Earth, Sun, supernovae, and the early Universe

evidence.text: How large can medium-dependent neutrino masses from light neutral-scalar interactions be in Earth, the Sun, supernovae, and the early Universe, after accounting for finite-temperature/density physics, long-range effects, and the experimental and cosmological constraints considered in the paper?

sources.title: Reflections on Parity Breaking

evidence.text: Which combinations of CP and fermion number select pin+ or pin− backgrounds, and how do neutrino mass terms restrict those choices?

sources.title: Searching new particles at neutrino telescopes with quantum-gravitational decoherence

evidence.text: Can hypothetical quantum-gravitational decoherence be distinguished from ordinary wave-packet separation in astrophysical neutrinos, and could its redistribution of states reveal additional neutral fermions, including sectors coupled only gravitationally?

sources.title: Constraining feeble neutrino interactions with ultralight dark matter

evidence.text: How strongly can terrestrial neutrino oscillations and cosmology constrain an ultralight dark-matter scalar that induces a time-dependent right-handed-neutrino Majorana mass, especially when neutrinos form nearly degenerate pseudo-Dirac pairs?

sources.title: Searching for a dark dimension right-handed neutrino in KATRIN

evidence.text: What tritium beta-spectrum signatures would KATRIN see if right-handed neutrinos propagate in a micron-scale dark dimension, and which compactification radii, bulk masses and brane couplings remain accessible after the imposed neutrino constraints?

sources.title: Neutrino electromagnetic interactions: a window to new physics

evidence.text: Which neutrino electromagnetic properties distinguish Dirac and Majorana particles, probe physics beyond the Standard Model, and produce laboratory or astrophysical signatures?

sources.title: Present and future constraints on flavor-dependent long-range interactions of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos

evidence.text: How strongly can estimated IceCube diffuse-flavor measurements and future neutrino experiments constrain flavor-dependent long-range interactions, accounting for standard mixing uncertainties?

sources.title: Constraints on flavor-dependent long-range interactions of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos

evidence.text: What constraints on flavor-dependent long-range neutrino–matter interactions follow from estimated IceCube flavor composition, and how could IceCube-Gen2 and improved oscillation parameters strengthen them?

sources.title: Cross-correlation power spectra and cosmic birefringence of the CMB via photon-neutrino interaction

evidence.text: Can Standard-Model photon–cosmic-neutrino forward scattering generate scalar-sourced CMB TB and EB correlations and cosmic birefringence, and can these effects distinguish Dirac from Majorana relic neutrinos or constrain neutrino–antineutrino asymmetry?

sources.title: Constraints on long-range neutrino interactions from a variety of $U(1)^\prime$ symmetries using atmospheric neutrinos at IceCube DeepCore

evidence.text: Do atmospheric neutrino data show flavor-dependent long-range interactions from anomaly-free U(1)′ symmetries, and what limits follow on their potentials and ultralight mediator mass–coupling parameter space?

sources.title: First Constraints on Long-Range Neutrino Interactions using IceCube DeepCore

evidence.text: Does the public IceCube DeepCore atmospheric-neutrino sample show flavor-dependent long-range interactions sourced by electrons, and what bounds follow for separately gauged Le−Lμ and Le−Lτ interactions?

sources.title: Updated results on neutrino mass and mass hierarchy from cosmology with Planck 2018 likelihoods

evidence.text: What bounds on the sum of three active neutrino masses follow from Planck 2018-era data when normal and inverted orderings are implemented explicitly, and how do mass priors and cosmological extensions affect hierarchy inference?

sources.title: Flavor-dependent long-range neutrino interactions in DUNE & T2HK: alone they constrain, together they discover

evidence.text: How strongly could DUNE and T2HK constrain flavor-dependent long-range neutrino interactions, and could their combination discover subdominant interactions despite degeneracies with standard oscillation parameters?

sources.title: Constraining Neutrino Masses, the Cosmological Constant and BSM Physics from the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Which proposed neutral fermions could populate the neutrino-scale spectrum, and which existing bounds depend on their thermal history or supersymmetry-breaking realization?

sources.title: Dimensional reduction and (Anti) de Sitter bounds

evidence.text: Could a relation between neutrino masses and vacuum energy connect the cosmological constant problem to the Higgs hierarchy?

sources.title: Probing long-range forces in neutrino oscillations at the ESSnuSB experiment

evidence.text: How tightly could ESSnuSB constrain flavour-dependent long-range neutrino forces, and would these interactions compromise CP-violation discovery or precision on δCP?

sources.title: Limits on neutrino electromagnetic properties: An update

evidence.text: What laboratory and astrophysical limits constrained neutrino electric charges, dipole moments and transition moments in 1999, especially for the small neutrino masses then favored? The review also derives a helioseismological constraint.

sources.title: A plethora of long-range neutrino interactions probed by DUNE and T2HK

evidence.text: How well could DUNE and T2HK constrain or discover flavor-dependent neutrino–matter interactions across fourteen candidate U(1)' symmetries, and distinguish their underlying symmetry if an interaction were found?

sources.title: NuFit-6.0: updated global analysis of three-flavor neutrino oscillations

evidence.text: What do global three-flavor oscillation data determine about six oscillation parameters, especially mass ordering, leptonic CP violation and the θ23 octant, and what conditional predictions follow for absolute-mass observables?

sources.title: Signatures of quasi-Dirac neutrinos in diffuse high-energy astrophysical neutrino data

evidence.text: Can quasi-Dirac active–sterile oscillations leave resolvable spectral or flavor signatures in the diffuse astrophysical neutrino flux after integration over cosmological sources, and what conditional constraints follow from published IceCube flux measurements?

sources.title: Dark dimension right-handed neutrinos confronted with long-baseline oscillation experiments

evidence.text: How do massive bulk right-handed neutrinos in a dark dimension change long-baseline oscillation spectra, and what constraints follow from T2K and NOvA when bulk masses exceed the compactification scale?

sources.title: String Landscape and Fermion Masses

evidence.text: Can flux-scanning probability distributions make small vacuum energy and fermion mass hierarchies statistically natural, constrain neutrino masses, and retain these features when the racetrack Kähler uplift model is extended?
